coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across visual/cloud/live-DB ERD tools for ICP competitors. Covered 7 primary products (Azimutt, ChartDB, dbdiagram.io, DrawSQL, DbSchema, Prisma Studio, ER Flow) with systematic collection of official homepages, pricing pages, documentation, changelogs, G2/Capterra reviews, competitive comparisons, and supporting analyses. Primary angle: HCI pain evidence through user reviews and feature comparisons; secondary angles: pricing/deployment models, database support breadth, collaboration capabilities, AI integration. Deduplication applied across multiple blog comparisons and alternative guides. Sources span T0 product pages (T0=38 sources: homepages, pricing, galleries), T1 official docs/changelogs/GitHub (16 sources), T2 review aggregates and analyst comparisons (8 sources: G2, Capterra, structured comparison articles), T3 practitioner articles/blogs (24 sources: Medium, Dev.to, vendor blogs, listicles, HN/forum discussions). Total: 86 sources. Notable gaps: specific TrustRadius reviews for most products (available but not captured in search results), detailed funding/cap table data (not systematically available for most), academic usability studies (2 arXiv papers found but limited direct HCI user research). Coverage achieved: comprehensive product-level visibility + user pain signal capture via review aggregates + competitive positioning via vendor comparison pages.
